profile_text.body:
Cognigy is a Düsseldorf-based enterprise customer service AI platform. The company describes itself as powering enterprise customer service with generative and conversational AI agents across voice and chat, emphasizing rapid deployment of AI agents in contact centers to deliver personalized service.

The company's product, also called Cognigy, is a conversational AI platform designed for customer service. It is GDPR-compliant with EU-hosted options available. The platform sits within the Enterprise AI Platforms & Agent Orchestration category.

The company has registered 18 cases in Delaware law exposure records, though no active litigation details are currently tracked.
